agaSteeringRally.desc: Switches between Grip (steering stops at the grip limit) and Rally (push the stick all the way to steer past the grip limit, up to full lock when slow). Saved to settings.
agaSteeringRally.onDown: local a = extensions.agaSteering if a then a.toggleRally() end
agaSteeringRally.title: AGA Steering: Grip / Rally

agaSteeringRecalibrate.desc: Re-measures the steering lock next time the car is stopped with the stick centred
agaSteeringRecalibrate.onDown: local a = extensions.agaSteering if a then a.recalibrate() end
agaSteeringRecalibrate.title: AGA Steering: recalibrate

agaSteeringToggle.desc: Turns the AGA gamepad steering assist off, or back on in the last mode. Saved to settings.
agaSteeringToggle.onDown: local a = extensions.agaSteering if a then a.toggle() end
agaSteeringToggle.title: AGA Steering: assist on / off

quickShiftToggle.desc: Turns QuickShift (quick coast downshifts and D / R changes) off, or back on
quickShiftToggle.onDown: local a = rawget(extensions, 'quickShift') or rawget(extensions, 'auto_quickShift') if a then a.toggle() end
quickShiftToggle.title: QuickShift: on / off

horizonCamera.desc: Switches to the Horizon chase camera
horizonCamera.title: DriveKit: Horizon camera
